scope: the typed call boundary and ALL persistent state of the two pilot laws (wave-22 touch band; stand-first hold) at the pinned baseline 371f80d6, as consumed by a P2-style lossless replay

substrate.contract: READ-ONLY; the instrument (tools/constraint_ledger/trace_harness.cpp) observes only; access-specifier relaxation for observation is declared and verified by double-run byte-equality + refusal cross-check

clock.tick: one controller decision per tick; dt = 1/tick_hz (tick_hz from scene recipe); CYCLE_TICKS = 300; horizon WALK = 10*CYCLE_TICKS = 300 with refusal-stop (measured refusal tick 295, gait_positional_correction_budget)

phases.reads: the touch law's SAME-TICK tick-start write (the declared record-input dependency: arming requires touching_prev_[hl] as updated this tick)

clock.row_convention: trace row j = status AFTER step j-1; row 0 is the reset row; decisions at row j are functions of rows <= j-1 plus the same-tick ordered dependency above; the touch law's current-tick write is recovered by the replay as row j+1's touching_prev_

law_1_touch_band.predicate: pair-min(pad gaps of the leg) <= kTouch -> touching; pair-min > kTouch+kReleaseBand -> released; between the two = hold current class (the hysteresis band)

persistent_state.name: touching_prev_[2]
persistent_state.reset: configure {reset:true} at construction; captured in trace as touch:[l,r] per row

inputs.name: hind pad gaps (4, pair-min per leg)
inputs.captured: decimal %.17g + uint64 IEEE bits per row (gaps/gaps_bits)

outputs: touch class per leg (consumed same-tick by law 2's arming; next-tick as touching_prev_)

law_2_stand_first_hold.kind: definition (arming/release/completion state machine, 2 instances: hind legs L/R)

persistent_state.name: hind_step_t_[2]
persistent_state.reset: reset(); captured decimal (NAMED: no bits column -- upgrade)

transitions.arming: at a step fire: live_slot phi_[hl] >= TOE_OFF(0.68) AND touching_prev_[hl] (SAME-TICK touch write) -> held=true, clear_tick=-1, plant_y=(heel_y+mp_y)/2-capture (lines 2445-2450: plant_y=from[1], the pad world y at the liftoff spot)
transitions.release: while mode==1 and held: pair-min > kTouch+kReleaseBand -> held=false, clear_tick=ticks_ (lines 2211-2216)
transitions.completion: mode==1 && t >= tair && pair-min <= kTouch -> replant completes, held=false (line 2238 region); tair in the trace meta row

inputs.name: phi_[hl]
inputs.captured: decimal %.17g per row (phase; NAMED: no bits column -- upgrade)

inputs.name: constants TOE_OFF, tair, T_CYCLE, DUTY_SAMPLED, tick_hz
inputs.captured: in the trace META row, dumped from the substrate

external_inputs_of_the_fragment: gaps, phases (phi_), fire events (the shipped scheduler's counters), mode, t, alt_due, pad world positions -- exactly the pilot preregistration's declared set; the scheduler itself is NOT a pilot record (named successor work)

adjacent_state_outside_the_two_laws.note: named for F-EVIDENCE-GAP completeness: these persistent members exist at the pin but are consumed by the SCHEDULER (the fire/waive/exchange decisions) or by census letters only -- no touch-band or hold decision reads them, so the two-law replay does not require them; they are the scheduler migration's state (L0 names them so the boundary is exhaustive by enumeration, not by omission)
members: hind_step_from_[2] (line 329): the liftoff spot -- consumed by the glide TARGET kinematics (lines 1568-1572); the hold's own anchor capture is plant_y
hind_step_to_[2], hind_step_ap_[2], hind_step_mp_[2], hind_step_branch_[2]: glide target/pose latch -- scheduler
hind_step_last_fire_[2]/hind_step_last_td_[2] (lines 341/342): consumed by the concentration gate (line 555) -- a fire-decision input, i.e. part of the external 'fire events' input class

hind_step_stall_[2] (line 440): per-swing census clock (reset at fire, ++ alongside hold_ticks at line 2217, consumed by a census print at line 2324) -- no decision reads it; hold_ticks (captured) increments in the same branch
ticks_, capture_events_, tables_, posture tables: substrate-level state pinned by the source tree digest and the meta row

reset_events: configure {reset:true} once before tick 0 (both binaries: gait_unit walk_run and trace_harness)

reset() (lines 2068-2078) zeroes every law-2 member and the touch latch; the trace's row 0 records the post-reset state and matches the declared initials exactly (measured: touch [0,0], held 0, clear_tick -1, plant_y bits 0, mode 0, t 0, phi {0,0.5})

losslessness.measurement_on_the_ship_trace: 2960 bit-pairs reconstructed from bits and re-encoded %.17g == recorded decimal, 0 mismatches; 1184 decimal-only round-trips clean; trace byte-identical across two runs
losslessness.verdict: the trace is a LOSSLESS representation of the required inputs and state: every float needed at the bit level carries its bits; the decimal-only fields are round-trip-exact by the %.17g property
